issues.description: Stock helper method naming differs between artifacts: the problem statement UML (and the reference solution) declare a method named addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient) on class Stock, while the template Stock implementation exposes a method named addItem(StockIngredient). This naming mismatch (addToStockIngredients vs addItem) can confuse students following the UML/specification or the reference solution because calls or instructions expecting addToStockIngredients will not match the starter code's API.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template API match the specification and reference solution to avoid student confusion. Either rename the template method addItem(StockIngredient) to addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient), or add a small delegating method public void addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient i) { addItem(i); } to the template Stock class. Alternatively, update the problem statement/UML to reference addItem instead, but keeping the template and spec consistent is recommended.
